Summary: The righteousness of God is both who he is and what he does: he is perfectly just, and he acts to make things right, vindicating the oppressed and judging the wicked. In the gospel, Paul announces something astonishing: God's righteousness is given to sinners through faith in Christ, so that the unjust are declared just. To trust in God's righteousness is to stop building our own and to rest in his finished work.
